title: Troll Movie Review
article:
In this article I will write about the Norwegian movie called Troll.



I thoroughly enjoyed this movie and it has many different emotions such as humor, and sadness. The plot is about a young girl named Nora Tiedmann, who goes adventuring with her father who is a professor of folktales. When Nora grows up her father starts to lose touch with reality and lives in the mountains, isolated from everyone. Nora on the other hand is a paleontologist who has just made a breakthrough on her 6 month long dig. But everything is interrupted when the Norwegian government decides to drill a tunnel through the Dourve Mountains. By doing this they disturbed the troll. The troll wreaks havoc all over southern Norway. How will they take down such a big monster? Watch to find out more.





Screen time: 101 minutes

Rated: TV-14

Language: Norwegian (english subtitles)
author: Sebastian Brodale
